title_ar: Analytics: الداتا البايظة والإحصاء والـsemantic model والتقرير (1/3)
title_en: Analytics: dirty data and applied steps, statistics from mean to A/B, the semantic model and the report (part 1 of 3)
how_to_read: sentences[].w = first..last word id inside this chapter; word k (0-based) of the sentence is first+k and `ar` is the spoken text (its space-separated tokens are those words); fr = [start_frame, end_frame] at 24 fps from the word map; impact = hook words (id=text); num = spoken numbers with data-contract fact ids; first_mention = glossary terms to chip (id=term); dup = same claim in another chapter. Anchor with {word, lead_frames} only. Visual candidates are ideas, never footage.

constraints.anchors: {word, lead_frames} only; never seconds or frames; event frame = word start - lead_frames
constraints.lead_frames: kinetic word -3, graphic state change -2, shot cut -4..-6 (inside a pause >= 200 ms), counter starts at the number word
constraints.density: >= 20 events/min; no gap > 4 s without an event (hold <= 6 s with reason); shot median 6-12 s, max 25 s (shots > 12 s: an event every 3 s)
constraints.coverage: every sentence >= 1 anchored event; >= 80 % of sentences a mechanism event; every spoken number and every first-mention term on screen
constraints.kinetic: 8-20 kinetic words per minute; <= 6 words and <= 2 lines on screen; impact word 1-2 words
constraints.fx: hero (real-time 3D) <= 5 % of chapter frames (ADR-002 RT5); fx_tier lite|standard|hero
constraints.text: text on busy backgrounds needs a plate or halo; sizes and safe areas: 04 sections 3.2 and 3.4
banned: invented numbers (every number: data-contract id or source sentence)
constraints.components: use only frozen components (harness/schemas/components/); requests go to corpus/specs/_component_requests.jsonl
constraints.chapter_rhythm: problem -> mental model -> progressive visual -> worked example -> prediction -> failure (crit) -> fix (ok) -> callback -> artifact (per chapter, not per sentence)

storyboard_notes.text: Restating dive: treat it as a visual callback that reuses the trunk chapter's assets (see `restates` in continuity); the fact-checker checks its numbers against the trunk.

sentences.ar: كتير بنشوف dashboards شكلها تحفة والأرقام اللي فيها بتحسسنا إن دا اليقين المطلق وما فيش أي مجال الغلط
sentences.en: We often see great-looking dashboards whose numbers make us feel it is absolute certainty with no room for error.

sentences.ar: بس الحقيقة وراء الأرقام دي رحلة طويلة جدا ومليانة فخاخ بتبدأ من الداتا البايظة لحد تفسيرات الإحصائية الغلط
sentences.en: But the truth behind those numbers is a long journey full of traps, from raw dirty data to wrong statistical interpretations.

sentences.ar: في التحليل ده إحنا هنفكك وهم اليقين حتة حتة
sentences.en: In this analysis we will take apart the illusion of certainty piece by piece.

sentences.ar: وهنشوف إزاي خطوط الداتا أو الـpipelines ممكن تنهار في صمت تام من غير ما أي حد يحس
sentences.en: We will see how data pipelines can collapse in complete silence without anyone noticing.

sentences.ar: يلا بينا عشان نكون على نور
sentences.en: Come on, so we are on the same page.

sentences.ar: خلينا نبص بسرعة على اللي هنغطيه
sentences.en: Let's quickly look at what we are going to cover.

sentences.ar: هنبدأ بالداتا البايظة وإزاي بنسجل خطوات تنظفها
sentences.en: We start with dirty data and how we record the cleaning steps.

sentences.ar: بعدين هنشوف الكارثة اللي بتحصل لو غيرنا ترتيب الخطوات
sentences.en: Then we will see the disaster that happens if we change the order of the steps.

sentences.ar: هندخل بعدها في الإحصاء ونفهم لعبة المتوسط والوسيط
sentences.en: After that we enter statistics and understand the game of mean and median.

sentences.ar: وننتقل لفترات الثقة واختبارات الـ A -B
sentences.en: Then we move to confidence intervals and A/B tests.

sentences.ar: وفي الآخر هنشوف إزاي سياق الفلتر بيلعب بنا في التقارير
sentences.en: Finally we will see how filter context plays tricks on us in reports.

sentences.ar: وهنختم بأهمية التصميم المرئي
sentences.en: And we close with the importance of visual design.

sentences.ar: طيب خلينا نبدأ بأول جزء الداتا البايظة والسجل للخطوات
sentences.en: Okay, let's start with the first part: dirty data and logging the steps.

sentences.ar: بصوا على الـgrid اللي قدامنا ده
sentences.en: Look at this grid in front of us.

sentences.ar: 15 صف الداتا خام زي ما طلعت من السيستم من الطلب 1001 لـ 1014
sentences.en: 15 rows of raw data, just as they came out of the system, from order 1001 to 1014.

sentences.ar: عندنا 8 عيوب بينوّروا قدامنا صف متكرر في 1008 مسافات زيادة في الأسماء
sentences.en: We have 8 defects lighting up in front of us: a duplicated row in 1008 and extra spaces in the names.

sentences.ar: استخدام الفصلة كعلامة عشرية واستخدام المسافة كفصل للألاف
sentences.en: Using the comma as a decimal mark and using a space as a thousands separator.

sentences.ar: وطبعاً الكوميديا كلها في كمية فاضية خالص في الطلب 1009
sentences.en: And of course the real comedy is an empty quantity in order 1009.

sentences.ar: واسم عميل مش موجود أصلاً في الطلب 1013
sentences.en: And a customer name that is missing altogether in order 1013.

sentences.ar: دي الكوارث اليومية بتاعتنا وهنا بقى بييجي دور التنظيف أو الـfunnel اللي بنعدّي فيه داتا
sentences.en: These are our daily disasters, and here comes the cleaning, the funnel we pass the data through.

sentences.ar: بس لما طبقنا خطوة الـTRIM عشان نشيل المسافات الزيادة الحداشر بقوا سبعة
sentences.en: But when we applied the TRIM step to remove the extra spaces, the eleven became seven.

sentences.ar: وبعدين استخدمنا دالة PROPER عشان نظبط حالة الحروف
sentences.en: Then we used the PROPER function to fix the letter case.

sentences.ar: عظيم جداً صح؟ بس تستنوا
sentences.en: Great, right? But hold on.

sentences.ar: فضل عندنا عميل واحد فاضي وده بقى دوال التنظيف ما بتعملوش حاجة
sentences.en: One empty customer remains, and the cleaning functions do nothing about that.

sentences.ar: زي ما انتوا شايفين في لستة الـApplied Steps اللي على الشمال احنا بنوثّق كل خطوة عملناها
sentences.en: As you can see in the Applied Steps list on the left, we document every step we took.

sentences.ar: عشان لما يجي ملف الشهر الجاي نشغل عليه نفس الليستة دي من غير ما نعيد الشغل ده كله من الصفر تاني
sentences.en: So when next month's file arrives, we run the same list on it without redoing all this work from scratch.

sentences.ar: ندخل بقى على الجزء التاني فخ ترتيب الخطوات والارقام
sentences.en: Let's move on to the second part: the trap of step order and the numbers.

sentences.ar: وهنا بنبدأ نشوف الكوابيس الحقيقية لمحلل البيانات قبل ما أقولكم الاجابة
sentences.en: And here we start to see the real nightmares of a data analyst, before I tell you the answer.

sentences.ar: خلينا نسأل سؤال التوقع ده وانفكر فيه للحظة
sentences.en: Let's ask this prediction question and think about it for a moment.

sentences.ar: تخيلوا عندنا pipeline شغال وزي الفل
sentences.en: Imagine we have a pipeline that is running perfectly.

sentences.ar: ومجرد اننا بدلنا خطوتين اتنين بس مكان بعض تفتكروا اجمالي المبيعات هيتغير
sentences.en: Just by swapping two steps with each other, do you think total sales will change?

sentences.ar: ولو اتغير هل السيستم هيطلع error ينبهنا
sentences.en: And if it changed, will the system raise an error to warn us?

sentences.ar: الاجابة الحقيقة مرعبة الاجمالي الاصلي كان 3948 يورو نص
sentences.en: The truth is frightening: the original total was 3948.5 euros.

sentences.ar: بس مجرد ما خلينا الفلتر يشتغل بعد الـgroup-by بدل ما كان قبله الرقم نط بقى 4177 يورو
sentences.en: But just by letting the filter run after the group-by instead of before it, the number jumped to 4177 euros.

sentences.ar: والكارثة الأكبر الـpipeline لونه اخضر وما فيش اي error طلع خالص
sentences.en: And the bigger disaster is that the pipeline is green and no error came up at all.

sentences.ar: السيستم بيقولك انا تمام وده اللي بنسميه الفشل الصامت
sentences.en: The system tells you I am fine, and this is what we call silent failure.

sentences.ar: اجابة واثقة جدا بس غلط 100 %
sentences.en: A very confident answer, but 100% wrong.

sentences.ar: وعشان نستوعب حجم اللخبطة اللي ممكن تحصل بصوا على اللوحة دي
sentences.en: To grasp the scale of the mess that can happen, look at this panel.

sentences.ar: اللي فيها اربع مجاميع مختلفة لنفس الداتا
sentences.en: It shows four different totals for the same data.

sentences.ar: 4177 ده لما اخرنا الفلتر
sentences.en: 4177 is what we get when we delayed the filter.

sentences.ar: 2148 ده حصل بسبب خطأ بسيط في الكتابة خلى قيمتين يقلبوا null في صمت
sentences.en: 2148 happened because of a small typing mistake that silently turned two values into null.

sentences.ar: وأخيرا 3853 ونص وده حصل لما قررنا نعتبر الكمية الفاضية بصفر
sentences.en: And finally 3853.5, which happened when we decided to treat the empty quantity as zero.

sentences.ar: بيحدد احنا بنتعامل ازاي مع الداتا الفاضية
sentences.en: It determines how we deal with empty data.

glossary.rule: Explain the term in Egyptian Arabic the first time it appears; then use the original term naturally, in Latin script, inside Arabic sentences.
glossary.register_ar: Natural Egyptian, clear, calm, professional. Use إحنا and خلّينا نشوف and ببساطة where they help. No heavy Modern Standard Arabic. No exaggerated slang. Numbers are spoken naturally in Egyptian but displayed as Western digits.
glossary.register_en: Plain, direct, unhurried. Short sentences. No hype, no "imagine that…", no rhetorical questions that are not real prediction prompts. Say the number, then pause for half a beat before the next sentence — the pause is where the viewer reads the screen.
glossary.never_translate_rule: Explain them in Egyptian Arabic the first time they appear, then use the original term naturally.
glossary.on_screen: Western digits, Latin terms in LTR isolates, Egyptian Arabic copy (no MSA), no per-letter animation (04 section 3.4).

concepts.def_en: SQL clause that splits rows into groups sharing the same key values, so aggregates like S…
concepts.failure: Grouping on a dirty key, so one customer splits into many groups.

concepts.def_en: A marker meaning a value is missing or unknown, not zero or an empty string; comparing wi…
concepts.failure: Using = NULL instead of IS NULL, so rows with missing values silently disappear.

components.does: One whole word (or a tatweel-joined compound like الـKafka) on screen; never split per letter.
Up to 6 kinetic words on at most 2 lines, each word arriving on its own spoken word anchor.
A technical term chip (Latin in an LTR isolate) with an optional Arabic gloss; 28 px floor if spoken.
A counter that rolls from the previous value to the target over the spoken number (preset count).
An arrow from a label to a target layer (or a named part of it, 'layer.part').
Failure beat: glitch + low thud; flashes stay <= 3/s (WCAG 2.3.1).
Fix beat: the target settles into place with a settle chime.
The shot camera: move + ease + intensity; drift always on; optional impact nudges (<= 4 px) on anchors.
Match cut between a layer of this shot and one of the next.
Lower-third caption for a source, term, speaker or location.
Draw an SVG path (stroke reveal; RTL by default for Arabic layouts).
A data table (<= 8 columns, <= 12 visible rows); numbers come from a data_ref.
A fact table with dimension tables in 3D.
A panel of 1-6 KPIs with status colours.
Deep-Dive entry card with parent chapter and prerequisite concepts.
